findings.claim: The public sidecar listener entrypoints still start an unguarded server by passing `None` for the launch token, bypassing the sidecar authentication and surface-reduction path.
findings.evidence: `run_server_with_listener` derives `sidecar_mode` from `launch_token.map(...)` and only enables `SidecarGuard` when the token is `Some`, but `start_server_sidecar_with_listeners` passes `None` at the new `launch_token` argument and `start_server_sidecar_with_listeners_and_shutdowns` also passes `None`.
findings.suggested_fix: Require a `SidecarLaunchToken` for every sidecar-named start function, or explicitly rename/test-only isolate the unguarded helpers so they cannot be used as sidecar entrypoints.

findings.claim: Acceptance criterion 4.3 is still incomplete despite being part of the change boundary verification.
findings.evidence: The acceptance criteria include `- [ ] 4.3 Run the existing governance, middleware and live-harness tests once to confirm no regression; record output.` and the diff leaves it unchecked; the implementation notes further state `the lib unit tests in runtime_control.rs and middleware.rs were not run (4.3 open)`.
findings.suggested_fix: Run and record the existing governance, middleware, and live-harness regression tests, then mark 4.3 complete only if they pass.

findings.claim: Task 1.4 is marked complete even though its required standalone build/default-build absence verification was not performed.
findings.evidence: Criterion 1.4 requires verifying `cargo build --bin uar-env-probe --features server,test-probes` produces the probe and the default build does not, but the implementation notes say `cargo build --bin uar-env-probe` and the default-build absence were not run separately.
findings.suggested_fix: Run the two explicit build checks and record the output, or uncheck 1.4 until that verification exists.

findings.claim: Several tests no longer match the specified acceptance method because the implementation notes say they use a real standalone process instead of the required in-process server path.
findings.evidence: Criterion 2.15 requires `in-process standalone start via start_server_with_listener-backed entry`, and criterion 2.31 also says `standalone in-process server`; the implementation notes state `2.15, 2.17, 2.18 (regression guard), 2.30, 2.31: the standalone server runs as the real universal-agent-runtime process rather than in-process`.
findings.suggested_fix: Either restore the specified in-process coverage or amend the acceptance criteria before marking those items complete.
